spec.description: Focus on cancellation and channel ownership.

evidence.title: Go concurrency reference
evidence.content: The go statement starts a goroutine. An unbuffered channel synchronizes a send with a receive and has no storage for pending values.

questions.prompt: Which Go construct starts a goroutine?
questions.explanation: The go statement starts a goroutine.

questions.prompt: Which properties describe an unbuffered channel send?
choices: b. It synchronizes with a receive
c. It has no storage for pending values
questions.explanation: An unbuffered channel couples the send to a receive and has no pending-value storage.

verify.reasoning: The go statement starts a goroutine.
This fixture deliberately rejects the first key.
The send and receive synchronize and there is no buffer.
